hooks.command:
input=$(cat); cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(npm run sanity --silent 2>&1) && exit 0; if [ "$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r ".stop_hook_active // false")" = "true" ]; then printf "Orbit sanity checks still failing:
%s
" "$(printf %s "$out" | tail -30)" >&2; exit 0; fi; printf "Orbit sanity checks failed (npm run sanity):
%s
" "$(printf %s "$out" | tail -40)" >&2; exit 2
